mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: search_flights
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Search mock flights by origin, destination and date. Returns only flights with seats available.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var params = vars.searchParams --- payload filter (f) -> f.origin == params.origin and f.destination == params.destination and f.date == params.date and f.seatsAvailable > 0

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- [ { flightId: "SB101", airline: "IndiGo", origin: "COK", destination: "DEL", date: "2026-12-15", departure: "06:00", arrival: "08:45", price: 5200, seatsAvailable: 4 }, { flightId: "SB102", airline: "Air India", origin: "COK", destination: "DEL", date: "2026-12-15", departure: "11:30", arrival: "14:20", price: 6100, seatsAvailable: 2 }, { flightId: "SB103", airline: "Vistara", origin: "COK", destination: "DEL", date: "2026-12-15", departure: "18:00", arrival: "20:50", price: 7300, seatsAvailable: 6 }, { flightId: "SB201", airline: "IndiGo", origin: "DEL", destination: "BOM", date: "2026-12-20", departure: "07:15", arrival: "09:20", price: 4800, seatsAvailable: 3 }, { flightId: "SB202", airline: "SpiceJet", origin: "DEL", destination: "BOM", date: "2026-12-20", departure: "15:00", arrival: "17:05", price: 4300, seatsAvailable: 0 } ]

raise-error.doc:name: Raise error
raise-error.description: No flight found with that ID

raise-error.doc:name: Raise error
raise-error.description: No seats available on this flight

set-variable.value: #[%dw 2.0 output application/json --- { bookingId: correlationId, flightId: vars.flight.flightId, airline: vars.flight.airline, origin: vars.flight.origin, destination: vars.flight.destination, date: vars.flight.date, price: vars.flight.price, passengerName: vars.bookingRequest.passengerName, status: "CONFIRMED" }]
set-variable.doc:name: Set Variable

mcp:tool-listener.name: list_bookings

mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: search_hotels
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Search mock hotels by city code (DEL or BOM), check-in date (YYYY-MM-DD) and number of nights. Returns hotels with rooms available, including the stay total.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var p = vars.searchParams var n = p.nights as Number --- (payload filter (h) -> h.city == upper(p.city) and h.roomsAvailable > 0) map (h) -> h ++ { checkIn: p.checkIn, nights: n, total: h.nightlyRate * n }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- [ { hotelId: "H101", name: "Capital Grand", city: "DEL", stars: 5, nightlyRate: 9500, roomsAvailable: 3 }, { hotelId: "H102", name: "Lotus Inn", city: "DEL", stars: 4, nightlyRate: 5600, roomsAvailable: 5 }, { hotelId: "H103", name: "Metro Stay", city: "DEL", stars: 3, nightlyRate: 3800, roomsAvailable: 8 }, { hotelId: "H201", name: "Marine Suites", city: "BOM", stars: 5, nightlyRate: 11000, roomsAvailable: 2 }, { hotelId: "H202", name: "Harbour View", city: "BOM", stars: 4, nightlyRate: 6400, roomsAvailable: 4 }, { hotelId: "H203", name: "Budget Bay", city: "BOM", stars: 3, nightlyRate: 3200, roomsAvailable: 6 } ]

mcp:tool-listener.doc:name: MCP Server - Tool Listener
mcp:tool-listener.name: book_hotel
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Book a specific mock hotel for a named guest. Returns a bookingId on success.

raise-error.doc:name: Raise error
raise-error.description: No hotel found with that ID

raise-error.doc:name: Raise error
raise-error.description: No rooms available on this hotel

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var n = vars.bookingRequest.nights as Number --- { bookingId: correlationId, hotelId: vars.hotel.hotelId, hotelName: vars.hotel.name, city: vars.hotel.city, checkIn: vars.bookingRequest.checkIn, nights: n, nightlyRate: vars.hotel.nightlyRate, total: vars.hotel.nightlyRate * n, guestName: vars.bookingRequest.guestName, status: "CONFIRMED" }

mcp:tool-listener.name: get_travel_policy
mcp:tool-listener.mcp:description: Returns the company travel policy limits used to review itineraries.
